verdicts.matching_evidence: Factual mischaracterization of RANSAC in the methodology. Sec. 4.3 states: '...we employ RANSAC, which formulates the alignment as a differentiable optimal transport problem...' This is factually incorrect. RANSAC (Random Sample Consensus) is a non-differentiable, randomized sampling algorithm based on inlier maximization, whereas differentiable optimal transport usually refers to methods like Sinkhorn distances.
